footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $258M income tax benefit. No per-share figures were reported for these years.

Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 0.7% to $6.5B in 2025. Gross margin was 56.6%, versus 58.1% a year earlier, and operating income rose 45.9% to $89.0M, a 1.4% margin.
The net loss widened to $780M, or $0.00 per share, from $276M. Operating cash flow was $4.1B and free cash flow $1.8B, versus $2.1B; SK Telecom returned $1.2B through dividends.
watch: Net income includes a $258M tax benefit.
sources: SK Telecom Co., Ltd. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
